title: MakeIT business_process.yaml
description: Canonical, layout-free business-process contract. Lives at docs/business_process.yaml in each project repo. Produced by the makeit-bizproc Claude Code skill, consumed (parsed + rendered) by the dashboard ProcessesTab. Pixel geometry is intentionally NOT part of the schema — the diagram derives all coordinates deterministically from `lane` + `col`.

version.description: Schema version. Bump only on breaking changes.

project.description: Repo / project name this file describes.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, unique within the file.
Stable id, unique within the process; referenced by flow.from/to.

type.description: start/end = events (circles), task = activity (rounded rect), gateway = exclusive decision (diamond).

lane.description: Must match a lane.id within the same process.

col.description: Left→right column index. Drives deterministic layout; multiple nodes may share a col across different lanes.

sub.description: Optional service/system/module the step is automated by (e.g. qc_workflow). Renders the task with the system/artifact style.

from.description: Source node id (must exist in the same process).

to.description: Target node id (must exist in the same process).

label.description: Branch annotation, e.g. a gateway condition ("да" / "> 5%" / "повтор").
